title: Gravity/thermodynamics correspondence via black hole shadows
summary: The shadow of a black hole serves as a pristine window into the strong-gravity regime, with cuspy feature emerging as a smoking-gun signature of physics beyond the Kerr paradigm. In this paper, we extend the work of [arXiv:2601.15612 [gr-qc]] and study the detailed properties of the cuspy shadow by using the parametric expressions of the shadow boundary. From a topological perspective, we provide a rigorous topological classification of these shadows, categorizing them into distinct ``rectangular" and ``8-shape" topologies.
